reviewed-card-sha256-algorithm: plain sha256 over the card file bytes as they stood at 5889fc3 — the exact revision the reviewer judged. NOT the CE canonical digest: this card declares no blocks:, so ce task validate never reaches the quality-review-receipt check and prints no canonical digest. Pinning the reviewed revision rather than the closing revision keeps the value non-circular: the closing commit adds the pointer line that names this file. Migrated 2026-09-15 (TASK-401): the pin was a plain sha256 over the reviewed revision's bytes, which ce task validate can never match against the closed card; reissued as the CE canonical digest of the closed card — the exact value validate's own mismatch message prints. Review content, verdict and evidence are untouched.
